notes: Flutter Dart-AOT release, Linux GTK embedder. frame_ms = interval between consecutive FrameTiming rasterFinish timestamps (engine raster thread finished the frame, frame handed to the GTK/GL presenter; NOT a guaranteed screen-update timestamp; no visibility into X11 present). Only frames the engine actually rasterized are reported (a frame with no dirty layer is never produced, so no empty frames are counted); continuous redraw by a Ticker that dirties the scene every tick. Frames filtered to rasterFinish within the measured window [start,end] after a 2 s warm-up; timings are batched by the engine so 800 ms extra were waited. Engine switches env: default-backend. nav: Navigator with PageRouteBuilder slide (300 ms) and RawDialogRoute fade (200 ms); script = push B, push C, pop, pop (4 transitions) x5 = 20 per batch, one modal open+close after every cycle; batches repeat until the duration ends. Frames exist only while animating (no idle frames). A background Dart isolate spins an integer loop (~1 core).
